## How it was made

- Run on 2026-10-18 from 22:14:40 to 22:16:43 UTC (wall clock from the run's command log), one run, first attempt. ULog info field `boot_time_utc_us` is 1792361687678695. The log is `<rootfs>/log/2026-10-18/22_14_53.ulg`, the only `.ulg` in the rootfs, copied unchanged.
- Fresh, empty rootfs: the driver script deletes and recreates it, and the px4 console shows the parameter defaults being applied (`SYS_AUTOCONFIG: curr: 0 -> new: 1`, `SYS_AUTOSTART: curr: 0 -> new: 4018`).
- `<work>` below is the working directory of the generating machine (written `/path/to/work` in the script copies), and `<PX4>` is `<work>/px4/PX4-Autopilot-v1.17.0`.
- Invocation: `bash gz_quadtailsitter_transition.sh <work>/gz/rootfs_A gz_quadtailsitter_transition` (script below). The script exports `PATH=$PATH:<work>/gz/env/bin`, `HEADLESS=1` and `GZ_IP=127.0.0.1`, sources the build's `build/px4_sitl_gz/rootfs/gz_env.sh` (it sets `GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH`, `GZ_SIM_SYSTEM_PLUGIN_PATH` and `GZ_SIM_SERVER_CONFIG_PATH` to the PX4 tree's models, worlds, built gz plugins and `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/server.config`), and then, from inside the rootfs, runs `PX4_SIM_MODEL=gz_quadtailsitter <PX4>/build/px4_sitl_gz/bin/px4 -d <PX4>/build/px4_sitl_gz/etc`.
- PX4 starts the Gazebo server itself: v1.17.0 `ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/px4-rc.gzsim:50` runs `gz sim --verbose=1 -r -s <PX4>/Tools/simulation/gz/worlds/default.sdf`, and `ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/px4-rc.gzsim:52` starts the GUI only when `HEADLESS` is empty. No display server was started. The console shows `Gazebo simulator 8.10.0`, `gz_bridge] world: default, model: quadtailsitter_0` and `lockstep_scheduler] setting initial absolute time to 4176000 us`: PX4 time follows the Gazebo clock, so the boot times below are simulation time.
- The console also shows `Failed to load system plugin [libOpticalFlowSystem.so]` and `[libGstCameraSystem.so]`, which v1.17.0 `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/server.config:16-17` load for every world. Those two plugins were not built (see "Build"); the quad tailsitter model has no camera or optical flow sensor.
- Commands were sent with the px4 client binaries (`px4-param`, `px4-commander`, `px4-logger`, `px4-shutdown`), and each step was confirmed by polling `px4-listener`. Every command the script sent is therefore an internal command (source 1/1, `from_external` 0 in `vehicle_command`).
- Host: Linux x86_64. Load average (from `/proc/loadavg` in the command log) 0.55 at start, 3.04 at end. Between the arm and land commands 59.6 s of wall time passed for 59.1 s of simulation time ("sim t" as printed). pyulog reports 0 dropouts.
- Cleanup: px4 exited 0 after `shutdown`, after the logger had closed the file (`closed logfile, bytes written: 34095400`). The script's cleanup pattern `pkill -f 'bin/gz sim'` did not match the Gazebo server (its command line is `gz sim --verbose=1 -r -s ...`), so the command log shows an empty "remaining gz processes" line and no kill. The server was stopped by hand after the run. This did not touch the log, which was already closed and copied.

### Build

The PX4 tree is the v1.17.0 checkout used for the other v1.17.0 golden logs, built a second time in its own build directory so that `build/px4_sitl_default` (used by the SIH logs) stayed untouched. `git status` in that tree lists no modified file; six board support files for a non-SITL hardware target are missing from the checkout and are not part of this build.

Gazebo came from conda-forge only, installed with micromamba 2.0.5 (the conda-forge package `micromamba-2.0.5-0.tar.bz2`, SHA-256 `bfc2e3a414d651af7508c49998a12b5cf3c7029d56c5ef37c9a3248cd7faef78`):

```bash
MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX=<work>/gz/mroot micromamba create -y -p <work>/gz/env -c conda-forge --override-channels \
    --ssl-verify <CA bundle of the host's HTTPS proxy> \
    libgz-sim8 libgz-transport13 libgz-sensors8 libgz-plugin2 libgz-msgs10 gz-tools2 libopencv
micromamba clean -a -y
gz sim --versions    # 8.10.0
```

Resolved versions that matter (from `micromamba list` of that environment): libgz-sim8 8.10.0 (build py314h484a5df_3), libgz-transport13 13.5.0, libgz-sensors8 8.2.2, libgz-plugin2 2.0.4, libgz-msgs10 10.3.2, libgz-physics7 7.5.0, libgz-rendering8 8.2.2, libgz-gui8 8.4.0, libgz-common5 5.7.1, libgz-math7 7.7.0, libgz-utils2 2.2.1, libgz-fuel-tools9 9.1.1, libsdformat14 14.8.0, gz-tools2 2.0.3, ogre-next 2.3.3, ogre 1.10.12.1, dartsim-cpp 6.19.5, libprotobuf 7.35.1, libabseil 20260526.0, libopencv 5.0.0, qt6-main 6.12.0, ruby 3.4.2, libstdcxx 16.2.0, python 3.14.8 (the environment's own Python; PX4 and the scripts used the system Python 3.13.16 at `/usr/bin/python3`, because the environment's `bin` was appended to `PATH`).

PX4 build commands (`<PX4>` is the v1.17.0 tree, `<work>/gz/env` the environment above):

```bash
cmake -S <PX4> -B <PX4>/build/px4_sitl_gz -G Ninja -DCONFIG=px4_sitl_default -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo \
    -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<work>/gz/env -DPYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3 -DPython3_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3 \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=<work>/gz/tools/cxx_launcher.sh
CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<work>/gz/env ninja -k 0 -C <PX4>/build/px4_sitl_gz
```

`CMakeCache.txt` of that build confirms `CONFIG=px4_sitl_default`, `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo`, `CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja`, `CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/c++` (GCC 13.3.0) and the launcher. The resulting `build/px4_sitl_gz/bin/px4` is 59312824 bytes, SHA-256 `e5a61fed34857c01e5c28235c3dc5c0c7a66d4ac044dd0ef133d10705cfd68d9`, file time 22:09:11 UTC, before this run.

- The compiler launcher `cxx_launcher.sh` (below) is needed because conda-forge abseil and protobuf require C++17 while PX4 v1.17.0 compiles with `-std=gnu++14`. For sources under `src/modules/simulation/gz_*` only, it replaces `-std=gnu++14` with `-std=gnu++17` and adds `-Wno-error=deprecated-declarations` (protobuf deprecates `RepeatedField::Resize(int, const T&)`, which v1.17.0 `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/GZMixingInterfaceESC.cpp:81` and `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/GZMixingInterfaceWheel.cpp:79` call). For every source it turns `-I<work>/gz/env/include` into `-isystem`. No PX4 source file was changed.
- `-k 0` lets ninja finish everything else when a target fails. Two optional targets failed and were not built: the external OpticalFlow project (`opencv2/core/types_c.h` and `cv::undistortPoints` are gone in OpenCV 5.0.0), and `libGstCameraSystem.so` (the link cannot find `-lgstreamer-1.0`). The gz plugins that were built are `libGenericMotorModelPlugin.so`, `libBuoyancySystemPlugin.so`, `libMovingPlatformController.so`, `libSpacecraftThrusterModelPlugin.so` and `libTemplatePlugin.so`.
- The build was incremental: five ninja runs between 22:04 and 22:09 UTC while the setup was being fixed. The first stopped on the C++17 requirement of the conda headers, before the launcher was configured; the fourth stopped on the protobuf deprecation errors in the two `GZMixingInterface*.cpp` files. The launcher's last edit, the `-Wno-error` flag (file time 22:09:00 UTC), came before the fifth run, which recompiled those two files and relinked `bin/px4` at 22:09:11. Ninja tracks the compile command line, not the launcher's content, so objects compiled in earlier runs were not recompiled after later launcher edits. A clean build with the final launcher was not run.

## Parameters

No parameter was changed by the scenario. The script runs `param set MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT 20` at 7.948 s, but `MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT` was already 20.0, so the command printed nothing and the log has no parameter message for it: v1.17.0 `src/systemcmds/param/param.cpp:808` sets and prints a float parameter only when the new value differs. The 20 m comes from the VTOL defaults, `ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d/rc.vtol_defaults:15` (`param set-default MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT 20`), which `ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/airframes/4018_gz_quadtailsitter:8` sources. The parameter's own default is 2.5 (`src/modules/navigator/mission_params.c:58`).

The logged parameter changes (pyulog `changed_parameters`, 4) are written by PX4 itself on the ground: `EKF2_MAG_DECL` 3.4057650566101074 at 5.468 s (log start, same value as the initial one), and `CAL_BARO0_ID` 6619404, `CAL_BARO0_OFF` 0.0, `CAL_BARO0_PRIO` 50 at 9.476 s. pyulog counts 1244 initial parameters.

### Transition semantics seen in this log

- Front transition: `vehicle_vtol_state` 1 at 33.584 s, 4 ms after the `DO_VTOL_TRANSITION` row at 33.580 s; `vehicle_status` follows 12 ms later (33.596 s) with `in_transition_mode` and `in_transition_to_fw` true. `vehicle_type` stays ROTARY_WING for the whole front transition and turns FIXED_WING when the transition ends (vtol state 4 at 36.044 s, `vehicle_status` at 36.056 s).
- Back transition: `vehicle_vtol_state` 2 at 57.140 s; `vehicle_status` at 57.148 s has `in_transition_mode` true, `in_transition_to_fw` false, and `vehicle_type` already ROTARY_WING. The back transition ends with vtol state 3 at 61.532 s and `in_transition_mode` false at 61.540 s.
- This is how commander maps the VTOL state in v1.17.0: `vehicle_type` is FIXED_WING only in state 4 FW and ROTARY_WING in every other state, both transitions included (`src/modules/commander/Commander.cpp:2187-2190`); `in_transition_mode` is true in states 1 and 2 (`src/modules/commander/Commander.cpp:2197-2199`); `in_transition_to_fw` is true only in state 1 (`src/modules/commander/Commander.cpp:2206-2209`).
- No transition was aborted, and there is no quadchute.

### Flight values

- Calibrated airspeed (`airspeed_validated`) while in state 4 FW: 15.29 to 20.62 m/s (`VT_ARSP_TRANS` 15.0).
- Height above the local origin (`-vehicle_local_position.z`): 19.22 to 20.00 m in the multicopter loiter before the front transition, 19.75 to 20.02 m during the front transition, 19.16 to 24.20 m in fixed wing, 19.36 to 42.28 m during the back transition, and 42.16 to 44.58 m after it until AUTO_LAND. The highest value is 44.58 m at 62.264 s, 0.73 s after the back transition ended; the landing started from about 42 m.

- `vehicle_command_ack` (6 rows): 211 result 5 (IN_PROGRESS, result_param1 255) at 5.132 s and result 0 at 6.168 s, both to 194/12; 400 result 0 at 8.920 s; 22 result 0 at 12.040 s; 400 result 0 at 12.052 s; 21 result 0 at 67.672 s. There is no ack row for either 3000.
- `failsafe_flags` (190 messages, 5.392 s to 106.420 s), fields that are ever true (`mode_req_*` not listed): `local_position_invalid`, `local_position_invalid_relaxed`, `local_velocity_invalid`, `global_position_invalid` and `global_position_invalid_relaxed` from 5.392 s to 7.444 s (before the estimator had a position); `auto_mission_missing`, `offboard_control_signal_lost`, `manual_control_signal_lost` and `gcs_connection_lost` in every message (headless, no RC, no ground station, `NAV_DLL_ACT` 0); `fd_esc_arming_failure` from 37.376 s to 105.868 s. None of these produced a failsafe action: `vehicle_status.failsafe` is never true. `fd_esc_arming_failure` copies the failure detector's `FAILURE_ARM_ESC` bit (`vehicle_status.failure_detector_status` is 16 from 37.376 s to 105.868 s; v1.17.0 `msg/versioned/VehicleStatus.msg:81`, `src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/failureDetectorCheck.cpp:102-103`). That check reports a health failure (`src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/failureDetectorCheck.cpp:114`) and the warning below (`src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/failureDetectorCheck.cpp:118`), which is why `pre_flight_checks_pass` is false over the same span.

### Boot-time DO_GRIPPER

The first `vehicle_command` row is published by `payload_deliverer` at start-up, not by the script. `PayloadDeliverer::send_gripper_vehicle_command()` declares `vehicle_command_s vcmd;` without initializing it and sets only `timestamp`, `command` (211) and `param2` (1 = grab) (v1.17.0 `src/modules/payload_deliverer/payload_deliverer.cpp:239-244`; called at `src/modules/payload_deliverer/payload_deliverer.cpp:72`). Source, target, the other params and `confirmation` are whatever the stack held. Its acks go to that source system with the source component truncated to 8 bits (`src/modules/payload_deliverer/payload_deliverer.cpp:248`, `uint8_t target_component`): 17676 is 0x450C, so the acks go to 194/12. The ids differ from boot to boot (8/17020 in `payload_two_sources.ulg` and 132/34432 in `gz_x500_vision_hover.ulg`, in the same directory).

## Logged messages

All 20 'L' (logged string) messages were read with the pyulog API. There are no tagged 'L' messages. Two are above INFO (log_level 54):

| boot time | timestamp (us) | level | message (repr, so a trailing tab shows as `\t`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 37.376 s | 37376000 | WARNING (52) | `'[health_and_arming_checks] Preflight Fail: ESC failure detected'` |
| 45.832 s | 45832000 | ERROR (51) | `'[sensors] Accel #0 fail:  TIMEOUT!\t'` |

The second comes from the sensor voting (`src/modules/sensors/voted_sensors_update.cpp:308`), in fixed-wing flight; `ulog_messages` also shows it as a decoded event at EMERGENCY: `0:00:45.832 EMERGENCY: Accelerometer sensor #0 failure: Timeout`. The same two lines appear as `WARN` and `ERROR` in the px4 console output. Other `ulog_messages` lines at INFO: `Armed by internal command` 0:00:08.920, `Using default takeoff altitude: 20.00 m` 0:00:12.052, `Takeoff detected` 0:00:12.896, `Landing at current position` 0:01:07.672, `Landing detected` 0:01:43.864, `Disarmed by landing` 0:01:45.868.

## Extraction commands

Run in `testdata/sitl/v1.17.0` with pyulog 1.2.4, with `facts.py` and `tailsitter_extras.py` (below) saved outside `testdata`:

```bash
sha256sum gz_quadtailsitter_transition.ulg; stat -c '%s bytes' gz_quadtailsitter_transition.ulg
python3 -I /usr/local/bin/ulog_info gz_quadtailsitter_transition.ulg
python3 -I /usr/local/bin/ulog_messages gz_quadtailsitter_transition.ulg
python3 -I facts.py gz_quadtailsitter_transition.ulg SYS_AUTOSTART VT_TYPE MAV_TYPE MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT SDLOG_MODE SDLOG_PROFILE \
    NAV_DLL_ACT VT_ARSP_TRANS VT_TRANS_TIMEOUT VT_TRANS_MIN_TM VT_F_TRANS_DUR VT_B_TRANS_DUR VT_PITCH_MIN VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN \
    VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y VT_FW_QC_HMAX VT_FW_QC_P VT_FW_QC_R VT_FW_MIN_ALT CA_AIRFRAME \
    CA_ROTOR_COUNT COM_DISARM_LAND
python3 -I tailsitter_extras.py gz_quadtailsitter_transition.ulg
```

`facts.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""facts.py <log.ulg> [PARAM ...]: print the log facts quoted in a provenance file (pyulog 1.2.4).

Hash and size of the file; firmware and time info; the named parameters at log start and every
logged parameter change; every change of the listed vehicle_status, vtol_vehicle_status and
vehicle_land_detected fields; every failsafe_flags field that is ever set (mode_req_* skipped);
every vehicle_command and vehicle_command_ack row; every logged string ('L') message with its level.
Times are boot times in seconds (the ULog timestamp field divided by 1e6)."""
import hashlib
import os
import sys

from pyulog import ULog

path, wanted = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
h = hashlib.sha256()
with open(path, 'rb') as f:
    for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
        h.update(chunk)
print('sha256 %s size %d' % (h.hexdigest(), os.path.getsize(path)))
u = ULog(path)
info = u.msg_info_dict
for k in ('ver_sw', 'ver_sw_release', 'sys_toolchain_ver', 'boot_time_utc_us'):
    print('%s %s' % (k, info.get(k)))
print('start_timestamp %d last_timestamp %d dropouts %d file_corruption %s'
      % (u.start_timestamp, u.last_timestamp, len(u.dropouts), u.file_corruption))
print('initial_parameters %d changed_parameters %d' % (len(u.initial_parameters), len(u.changed_parameters)))
for n in wanted:
    print('param %s %s' % (n, u.initial_parameters.get(n, '<absent>')))
for t, n, v in u.changed_parameters:
    print('changed %.3f %s %s' % (t / 1e6, n, v))


def topic(name):
    return [d for d in u.data_list if d.name == name]


def changes(name, fields):
    for d in topic(name):
        t, prev = d.data['timestamp'], None
        print('%s multi %d: %d rows, %.3f to %.3f' % (name, d.multi_id, len(t), t[0] / 1e6, t[-1] / 1e6))
        for k in range(len(t)):
            cur = tuple(int(d.data[f][k]) for f in fields)
            if cur != prev:
                print('  %.3f %s' % (t[k] / 1e6, ' '.join('%s=%d' % p for p in zip(fields, cur))))
                prev = cur


changes('vehicle_status', ['arming_state', 'nav_state', 'failsafe', 'in_transition_mode', 'in_transition_to_fw',
                           'vehicle_type', 'pre_flight_checks_pass', 'latest_disarming_reason', 'system_id'])
changes('vtol_vehicle_status', ['vehicle_vtol_state', 'fixed_wing_system_failure'])
changes('vehicle_land_detected', ['landed'])
for d in topic('failsafe_flags'):
    t = d.data['timestamp']
    print('failsafe_flags multi %d: %d rows, %.3f to %.3f' % (d.multi_id, len(t), t[0] / 1e6, t[-1] / 1e6))
    for f, v in d.data.items():
        if f == 'timestamp' or f.startswith('mode_req_'):
            continue
        ch = ['%.3f->%d' % (t[k] / 1e6, v[k]) for k in range(len(t)) if k == 0 or v[k] != v[k - 1]]
        if len(ch) > 1 or v[0]:
            print('  %s: %s' % (f, ' '.join(ch)))
for d in topic('vehicle_command'):
    c = d.data
    print('vehicle_command multi %d: %d rows' % (d.multi_id, len(c['timestamp'])))
    for k in range(len(c['timestamp'])):
        print('  %.3f cmd=%d src=%d/%d tgt=%d/%d p1..p7=%s conf=%d ext=%d'
              % (c['timestamp'][k] / 1e6, c['command'][k], c['source_system'][k], c['source_component'][k],
                 c['target_system'][k], c['target_component'][k],
                 ','.join('%.6g' % c['param%d' % j][k] for j in range(1, 8)),
                 c['confirmation'][k], c['from_external'][k]))
for d in topic('vehicle_command_ack'):
    a = d.data
    print('vehicle_command_ack multi %d: %d rows' % (d.multi_id, len(a['timestamp'])))
    for k in range(len(a['timestamp'])):
        print('  %.3f cmd=%d result=%d result_param1=%d tgt=%d/%d ext=%d'
              % (a['timestamp'][k] / 1e6, a['command'][k], a['result'][k], a['result_param1'][k],
                 a['target_system'][k], a['target_component'][k], a['from_external'][k]))
print("'L' messages %d, tagged %d" % (len(u.logged_messages), len(u.logged_messages_tagged)))
for m in u.logged_messages:
    print('  %.3f %d %s %r' % (m.timestamp / 1e6, m.log_level, m.log_level_str(), m.message))
```

```python
import sys
import numpy as np
from pyulog import ULog
u = ULog(sys.argv[1])
a = u.get_dataset('airspeed_validated').data
m = (a['timestamp'] >= 36044000) & (a['timestamp'] < 57140000)  # vtol state 4 (FW)
print('FW calibrated airspeed %.2f to %.2f m/s' % (a['calibrated_airspeed_m_s'][m].min(), a['calibrated_airspeed_m_s'][m].max()))
lp = u.get_dataset('vehicle_local_position').data
t, h = lp['timestamp'], -lp['z']
for name, lo, hi in [('MC loiter before front transition', 28244000, 33584000), ('front transition', 33584000, 36044000),
                     ('fixed wing', 36044000, 57140000), ('back transition', 57140000, 61532000),
                     ('MC after back transition, before land', 61532000, 67684000)]:
    m = (t >= lo) & (t < hi)
    print('%s: -z %.2f to %.2f m' % (name, h[m].min(), h[m].max()))
k = int(np.argmax(h))
print('highest -z %.2f m at %.3f s' % (h[k], t[k] / 1e6))
```

## The scripts that drove the flight and the build

The scripts used absolute paths under a working directory of the generating machine. In the copies below that directory is written `/path/to/work`; nothing else differs from the files that ran.

`gz_quadtailsitter_transition.sh` (as run: SHA-256 `6935ad9d6dec202b5dd492cc8ba1527544c0c1901ba5c2a9abd7bb9bb9117545`, 79 lines; lines 7 and 8 hold the replaced prefix). The script's comment says "~20 s in FW"; the log shows 21.1 s.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# gz_quadtailsitter_transition.sh <rootfs_dir> <scenario_name>
# Flight A: Gazebo Harmonic quad tailsitter (4018_gz_quadtailsitter, VT_TYPE 0), arm, takeoff
# (MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT set to 20 m), transition to FW, fly ~20 s in FW (AUTO_LOITER, no stick input
# available headless), transition back to MC, commanded land, auto-disarm. Fresh rootfs, headless gz.
set -u
PX4_DIR=/path/to/work/px4/PX4-Autopilot-v1.17.0
GZ_DIR=/path/to/work/gz
BUILD=$PX4_DIR/build/px4_sitl_gz
BIN=$BUILD/bin
ETC=$BUILD/etc
OUT=$GZ_DIR/logs
ROOTFS=${1:?rootfs}; SCENARIO=${2:?scenario}
MODEL=gz_quadtailsitter
rm -rf "$ROOTFS"; mkdir -p "$ROOTFS" "$OUT"; cd "$ROOTFS"
PX4LOG=$OUT/$SCENARIO.px4.log; CMDLOG=$OUT/$SCENARIO.cmd.log; : > "$CMDLOG"
# Gazebo Harmonic from the conda-forge env (appended so system python3 stays first)
export PATH=$PATH:$GZ_DIR/env/bin
export HEADLESS=1 GZ_IP=127.0.0.1
set +u; . "$BUILD/rootfs/gz_env.sh"; set -u
ts() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3N; }
say() { echo "[$(ts)] $*" | tee -a "$CMDLOG"; }
simt() { "$BIN/px4-listener" vehicle_status 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ +timestamp:/{printf "%.3f", $2/1e6}'; }
vs() { say "STATUS: $("$BIN/px4-listener" vehicle_status 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ +(timestamp|arming_state|nav_state|failsafe|vehicle_type|in_transition_mode|in_transition_to_fw|pre_flight_checks_pass):/{gsub(/^ +/,""); printf "%s | ", $0}') VTOL: $("$BIN/px4-listener" vtol_vehicle_status 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ +(vehicle_vtol_state|fixed_wing_system_failure):/{gsub(/^ +/,""); printf "%s | ", $0}') ARSPD: $("$BIN/px4-listener" airspeed_validated 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ +(calibrated_airspeed_m_s|airspeed_source):/{gsub(/^ +/,""); printf "%s | ", $0}') POS: $("$BIN/px4-listener" vehicle_local_position 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ +(z|vx|vy|vz):/{gsub(/^ +/,""); printf "%s | ", $0}')"; }
cmd() { say "CMD (sim t=$(simt)s): $*"; "$BIN/px4-$1" "${@:2}" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/    > /' | tee -a "$CMDLOG"; }
wait_for() { # topic field value timeout_s
  local tp=$1 f=$2 v=$3 to=$4 i=0 cur=
  while [ $i -lt "$to" ]; do
    cur=$("$BIN/px4-listener" "$tp" 2>/dev/null | awk -v f="$f" '$1==f":"{print $2}')
    if [ "$cur" = "$v" ]; then say "WAIT ok: $tp.$f=$v after ${i}s (sim t=$(simt)s)"; return 0; fi
    sleep 1; i=$((i+1))
  done
  say "WAIT TIMEOUT: $tp.$f=$cur (wanted $v) after ${to}s (sim t=$(simt)s)"; return 1
}
say "SCENARIO $SCENARIO  rootfs=$ROOTFS  PX4 $(cd $PX4_DIR && git describe --tags --always) $(cd $PX4_DIR && git rev-parse HEAD)"
say "gz: $(gz sim --versions 2>/dev/null | head -1)  host load at start: $(cat /proc/loadavg)"
touch .start_marker
say "START px4: cd $ROOTFS && . $BUILD/rootfs/gz_env.sh && HEADLESS=1 GZ_IP=127.0.0.1 PX4_SIM_MODEL=$MODEL $BIN/px4 -d $ETC > $PX4LOG 2>&1 &"
PX4_SIM_MODEL=$MODEL "$BIN/px4" -d "$ETC" > "$PX4LOG" 2>&1 &
PX4_PID=$!
sleep 5
wait_for vehicle_status pre_flight_checks_pass True 180
wait_for home_position valid_hpos True 60
cmd param set MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT 20
cmd param show SYS_AUTOSTART; cmd param show VT_TYPE; cmd param show MAV_TYPE; cmd param show MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT; cmd param show VT_ARSP_TRANS; cmd param show VT_TRANS_TIMEOUT; cmd param show VT_TRANS_MIN_TM; cmd param show VT_F_TRANS_DUR; cmd param show VT_B_TRANS_DUR; cmd param show VT_FW_QC_*
vs
cmd commander arm
sleep 3; vs
cmd commander takeoff
wait_for vehicle_status nav_state 17 10; vs
wait_for vehicle_status nav_state 4 120; vs
sleep 5; vs
cmd commander transition
sleep 1; vs
wait_for vehicle_status in_transition_mode True 10; vs
wait_for vehicle_status in_transition_mode False 40; vs
sleep 5; vs
sleep 5; vs
sleep 5; vs
sleep 5; vs
cmd commander transition
sleep 1; vs
wait_for vehicle_status in_transition_mode False 40; vs
sleep 5; vs
cmd commander land
wait_for vehicle_status nav_state 18 10; vs
wait_for vehicle_status arming_state 1 240; vs
sleep 6
cmd logger status
cmd shutdown
wait $PX4_PID; say "px4 exit=$?"
sleep 2
say "remaining gz processes: $(pgrep -af 'bin/gz sim' | tr '\n' ';')"
pkill -f 'bin/gz sim' && say "killed gz sim server"
ULG=$(find log -name '*.ulg' -newer .start_marker | sort | tail -1)
cp "$ULG" "$OUT/$SCENARIO.ulg"; cp "$0" "$OUT/$SCENARIO.sh" 2>/dev/null
say "COPIED $ROOTFS/$ULG -> $OUT/$SCENARIO.ulg ($(stat -c %s "$OUT/$SCENARIO.ulg") bytes)"
say "host load at end: $(cat /proc/loadavg)"
say "DONE"
```

`cxx_launcher.sh`, the compiler launcher of the PX4 build (as used: SHA-256 `5c0f648bb6db3933130b9cbb968a9f3453b2fd68df3f8e1e3809b86aa65d47f1`, 20 lines; line 9 holds the replaced prefix):

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Compiler launcher for the PX4 gz build against conda-forge Gazebo Harmonic.
# conda-forge abseil/protobuf require C++17, PX4 v1.17 builds with -std=gnu++14.
# For gz simulation sources only, swap -std=gnu++14 -> -std=gnu++17.
# For all sources, treat the conda env include dir as a system include dir (-isystem)
# so -Werror is not applied to third-party headers.
# For gz sources also add -Wno-error=deprecated-declarations (protobuf 35 deprecates
# RepeatedField::Resize(int, const T&), used by gz_bridge; a warning only).
GZENV=/path/to/work/gz/env
args=("$@")
gz=0
case "$*" in *"/modules/simulation/gz_"*) gz=1 ;; esac
out=()
for a in "${args[@]}"; do
  if [ $gz = 1 ] && [ "$a" = "-std=gnu++14" ]; then out+=("-std=gnu++17")
  elif [ "$a" = "-I$GZENV/include" ]; then out+=("-isystem" "$GZENV/include")
  else out+=("$a"); fi
done
[ $gz = 1 ] && out+=("-Wno-error=deprecated-declarations")
exec "${out[@]}"
```
